text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh!? What's this, a pimple...?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... A place like this... it'll totally 
mess up your eyes...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...No. Now's no time to be moping. 
Thinking I'm slacking off just 'cause my 
skin's acting up— I can't let anyone think 
that!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Cosmetics, diet... I need to re-evaluate 
my sleep schedule too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking her skin trouble as a wake-up call, 
Lucky Lilac braced herself once more as 
the star of the show.
